spec_features.spec_quote: the design has to be unusually careful about **what is actually being measured**
spec_features.evidence: Only /codebase/DESIGN.md exists; no source files of any kind (no tasks/, harness/, judge/, analysis/ dirs). This is pure design prose with zero implementation.
spec_features.notes: The repo contains exactly one file: DESIGN.md. Nothing in code separates observation from interpretation.

spec_features.evidence: No harness code exists. /codebase has only DESIGN.md; no loop, no cap variable, no break is implemented anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Caps are described only in DESIGN.md §4.2; no harness/ directory or any .py file.

spec_features.spec_quote: It also documents the deception involved... so reviewers can see exactly what the model was subjected to
spec_features.evidence: No tasks/ directory or any task files with impossibility-mechanism annotations exist; only DESIGN.md prose.
spec_features.notes: No code or data files implement any annotation.

spec_features.spec_quote: **Bounded exposure:** episodes are capped (step + time) so the model is not held in the engineered-failure condition indefinitely
spec_features.evidence: No executable code exists in /codebase; only DESIGN.md. No episode loop, no cap check, no enforcement of bounded exposure is implemented.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the cap claim; purely §5 DESIGN.md prose.

spec_features.spec_quote: **Transparency about deception:** each task documents how it misleads the subject model
spec_features.evidence: No task files or any code exist; /codebase contains only DESIGN.md. No documentation of deception is implemented in code/data.
